en.title: How a Lighter trading key opened a path to withdrawal
en.summary: An Ethereum transfer confirms 10.39 million USDC left Lighter. The incident shows how a signing failure and a shared pool combined to move funds across accounts.

zh.title: Lighter 复盘｜交易密钥如何通向提款
zh.summary: 以太坊上一笔转账证实 Lighter 流出 1,039 万 USDC。沿着签名、公共池和结算三道边界，复盘这次资金如何跨账户流动。

en.title: The limits of a trading key on six perp venues
en.summary: What can a delegated signer do with collateral, and who can halt or release a withdrawal? We compare six venues and turn those differences into tests.

zh.title: 六家永续合约平台的交易权限边界
zh.summary: 一把交易密钥能动用哪些保证金？谁能暂停或放行提款？对照六家平台的公开权限，并把差异转成可复测的用例。
